text_block_list.name: Overseas Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Do you know how to<n>get to this
hotel?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello! And sure. If you head<n>toward that traffic
light... Hm, never<n>mind, I'll just show you the way!
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I got them there safe and<n>sound, but I had
no idea it'd be so far<n>away...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And it's going to take just as long to<n>get back...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl ends up exhausted<n>after guiding
a lost tourist to their<n>destination.
